subject: Runbook: Senior ML Platform candidate — interview scheduling + access requests
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@gmail.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runbook: Senior ML Platform candidate — interview on Apr 10

Hi Alex (and team),

Thanks for confirming availability. Below is the runbook for the on-site-remote loop on Apr 10. Please read — flag any access needs.

Zoom (primary): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (Passcode: Redwood2027)
Backup dial-in: +1 415 555 0102 (PIN 4321)

Agenda (PST) — total 90 minutes
- 09:00-09:10 — Welcome + intro (Priya / Logan)
- 09:10-09:40 — System design (Logan) — 30m
- 09:40-10:05 — Coding exercise (pairing) (Soojin) — 25m
- 10:05-10:25 — Behavioral / cross-team (Karthik) — 20m
- 10:25-10:30 — Wrap + next steps

Accessibility & logistics notes:
- We have a 20-minute buffer after the coding section if extra time is needed — please let me know if you want that to be scheduled earlier.
- If you require live captions or an interpreter, tell me in this thread and I will arrange.

Attachments: alex_jenkins_resume.pdf (candidate-provided), panel_quicknotes.txt (short interviewer prompts).

Interviewer quick asks:
- Please open the debrief form (linked below) immediately after the loop to capture notes while fresh.
- For the pairing exercise, share your screen and use gallery view; keep chat enabled for links.

Debrief form: https://docs.redwood.ai/debriefs/form/MLPL-INT-2027
Calendar event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234-ml-platform-interview

@Logan: if you want to swap the order of SD and pairing, say the word — I can update calendar.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0168

---
Attachments: alex_jenkins_resume.pdf (resume, 1 page), panel_quicknotes.txt (2 KB)
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@gmail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Best Talent <talent@besttalent.co>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runbook: Senior ML Platform candidate — interview on Apr 10

Hi Priya — thanks for the details and the calendar invite. Two quick accessibility notes: 

1) I use a screen reader occasionally; Zoom with automatic live captions helps a lot. Could you enable live captions or provide a link for captions?
2) If possible, I'd like an ASL interpreter for my family member who will be on the call for part of the intro. They will join for the first 10 minutes.

My phone (in case of last-minute issues): +1 646 555 0199.

Happy to share any additional info you need. Looking forward to the loop.

— Alex
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@gmail.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runbook: Senior ML Platform candidate — interview on Apr 10

Thanks for flagging this, Alex. Priya — can you engage Accessi-Pro (ASL vendor) for the first 10 minutes and confirm live captions?

We'll keep the 20-minute buffer after the pairing exercise; if the candidate prefers to use that earlier, we can shift 10 minutes from the behavioral slot.

Soojin — would you be ok swapping pairing to occur immediately after the intro (09:10) and move system design to 09:40? That gives Alex the pairing momentum sooner.

Also note: small change to the pairing environment — use the shared editor link (VS Code Live Share) instead of Zoom remote control. I'll post the link in the calendar event once Priya confirms captions/interpreter.

— Logan
Head of ML Platform
logan_wright@redwood.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runbook: Senior ML Platform candidate — interview on Apr 10

Sounds good. I can swap and run the pairing at 09:10. Quick reminders for the panel (copied into panel_quicknotes.txt but repeating here):

- Start the Zoom welcome with captions turned on (Zoom: Live Transcription -> Enable Auto-Transcription).
- For pairing: open the VS Code Live Share link, share terminal only for run, and avoid remote control; candidate should drive.
- Keep the whiteboard/diagram questions minimal — we want to surface system reasoning, not rote syntax.
- After the loop, please complete the debrief form before leaving the meeting. It is short but required.

On the calendar event I'll add the VS Code Live Share link and a short note: "Interpreter scheduled 09:00-09:10 via Accessi-Pro" once Priya confirms booking.

Thanks — see you all on the 10th.
— Soojin
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@gmail.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, accessi-pro@aslservices.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Reminder: Senior ML Platform interview tomorrow — calendar + day-of checklist

Hi all — day-before reminder. Final confirmations below.

- Confirmed ASL interpreter: Accessi-Pro will join 09:00–09:10 (accessi-pro@aslservices.com).
- Live captions: Enabled in Zoom auto-transcription for the whole meeting.
- VS Code Live Share link (pairing): https://liveshare.vseng.com/join/xyz-mlpl
- Zoom primary & passcode: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (Passcode: Redwood2027)
- Dial-in fallback: +1 415 555 0102 (PIN 4321)

Day-of checklist for interviewers (attached as day_of_cheat_sheet.pdf):
- 5 min before: Open debrief form, have calendar + resume visible.
- During pairing: candidate leads, interviewer narrates thought process prompts only.
- Immediately after: submit debrief (link below).

Debrief form: https://docs.redwood.ai/debriefs/form/MLPL-INT-2027

Alex — if you need anything else before tomorrow (alternate dial-in, extra buffer, or a shorter intro), let me know and I will update the event.

Thanks everyone, see you tomorrow.

Priya Natarajan
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
